summary: Regulatory and legal actions dominate today's briefing, with SEBI cracking down on financial fraud while courts order new investigations. Separately, Reliance plans a $1.3 billion rupee bond sale and Tata's chip expansion adds 450 suppliers.

bullets.text: SEBI bars Kore Digital promoters over alleged Rs 541 crore revenue misstatement, citing misstated financials and diversion of preferential issue proceeds.
Delhi court orders FIR against Karishma Aziz over derogatory remarks against PM Modi, Savarkar and Hinduism.
Reliance to raise $1.3 billion in first rupee bond sale since 2023, per Mukesh Ambani's company filing.
Tata Electronics' chip plant will have 450 suppliers housed in new 363-acre vendor park near manufacturing facility.
Kissht parent OnEMI board approves Rs 832 crore preferential issue at Rs 314.11 per share to 34 non-promoter investors.
